acceptanceCriteria: Fixture and native queues behave as before.
The V1-0184 Beamfall daily-path change can record its task in the imported store without a fixture session.
corvint-tasks durably applies mutations to a non-fixture queue that has an import map, through a specified writer with its own requirements and tests.
body: Requested on 2026-09-27 by the Beamfall session as a prerequisite for V1-0184, and filed on owner approval. The Beamfall daily path needs its task store written durably, and that store is imported. corvint-tasks refuses every durable transaction whose queue is not a fixture, or has an import map or execution cutover: internal/transaction/model.go:616 in the corvint-tasks repository returns MALFORMED "unsupported queue identity/state". There is no supported writer for an imported store outside the fixture path. This is work in the corvint-tasks repository; decision 0423 A10 freezes corvint-tasks after 1.0.0-rc.1, so it needs an owner exception or lands before the freeze.
title: corvint-tasks: non-fixture durable writer for imported stores
